empty.library.title: Your library is waiting
empty.library.body: Drag font files, folders, or .zip archives anywhere in this window to install them →
empty.search.title: No fonts match
empty.search.body: Try a shorter search, fewer filters — or a different tag.
empty.favorites.title: No favorites yet
empty.favorites.body: Open a font and click the star — favorites collect your go-to typefaces here.
empty.lastImported.title: Nothing imported yet
empty.lastImported.body: Drag font files anywhere into this window — the latest batch always shows up here.
empty.collection.title: This collection is empty
empty.collection.body: Right-click any font → Collections → “{name}” to add it here.
empty.tag.title: Nothing wears this tag
empty.tag.body: Right-click a font and pick Tags to label it.
empty.activated.title: Nothing activated yet
empty.activated.body: Activate a font and it will show up here.
empty.session.title: No session fonts
empty.session.body: Use “Activate until close” and the font stays here until you quit.
empty.deactivated.title: Everything is active
empty.deactivated.body: Fonts you deactivate will collect here.
empty.system.title: No system fonts found
empty.system.body: Fonts installed with the OS would show up here.
empty.folder.title: No fonts in this folder
empty.folder.body: No fonts were found in {path}. Add font files there, or check that the folder still exists.

trash.emptyBody: Fonts you remove land here first — nothing is ever silently deleted.
about.portable: Portable mode · settings are kept next to the app
about.desc: The font manager Linux never got and Windows/macOS have to pay for. Preview, tag, activate and deactivate, and install fonts across all three OSes from one clean native app — your fonts never leave your machine.
drop.title: Drop to install
drop.toCollection: Or drop onto a collection to add the fonts to it
detail.visibleElsewhere: Visible in other apps' font pickers
detail.systemFont: System font — managed by the OS
detail.conflictBody: Multiple installed files claim the same identity. Apps may pick either one unpredictably.
detail.duplicateBody: These files contain the same font. No more than one of them is switched on, so other apps aren't affected. If you switch on more than one, apps may pick either.
detail.conflictSystemProtected: System font — protected, can't be removed or trashed
note.placeholder: Notes — e.g. licensed for Client X only…
license.disclaimer: Best-effort reading of embedded metadata — not legal advice
settings.title: Settings
settings.closeToTraySub: Closing the window keeps ZFontManager running in the tray.
settings.autostartSub: Launch ZFontManager when you sign in.
settings.startMinimizedSub: Start in the tray without opening the window.
settings.watchSub: Rescan automatically when fonts appear in scanned folders
settings.autoActivateSub: Newly imported fonts start active right away (small batches under 64 only)
settings.watchedFoldersSub: Scanned in addition to your system font folders. Their fonts stay off until you switch them on
settings.affinityDeactivateSub: Turn session fonts off when Affinity closes
settings.affinityHelp: Needs Affinity 3.2+ with Settings > Model Context Protocol enabled (restart after).
settings.onlineEnableSub: Search a catalogue of open-licence fonts and add them to your library
settings.onlineHosts: Contacts api.fontsource.org, cdn.jsdelivr.net, raw.githubusercontent.com, github.com and release-assets.githubusercontent.com — only while you browse, search or download
settings.onlineHelp: Nothing is sent until you open the Online section. Your own library is never uploaded. Fonts come from the google/fonts repository and the official Nerd Fonts releases, with their licence text.
settings.curationSub: Back up your curation to a file, or merge one in from another machine
settings.translateSub: Add it yourself with a small pull request — or just ask, and I will add it.
settings.themeSub: Dark, light, or follow your desktop
settings.reduceMotionSub: Replace springs with quick fades, regardless of system setting
settings.reduceTransparencySub: Solid panels instead of frosted glass — clearer to read, and much lighter on older graphics
settings.interfaceSoundsSub: Soft synthesized feedback for toggles and notifications
shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
sc.zoomWheel: Preview size (glyph size over the glyph grid)
sc.contextMenu: Context menu — arrows to browse it
palette.placeholder: Jump to a font or run a command…
tour.inviteSub: A short walkthrough of every part of the window.
tour.welcome.title: Welcome to ZFontManager
tour.welcome.body: This tour points at each part of the window and says what it does. Use the arrow keys or Enter to move on, and Esc to leave. You can replay it any time from Settings, under About.
tour.sample.title: Your own sample text
tour.sample.body: Whatever you type here replaces the preview in every card. AA shows it in capitals, and the arrow brings the default sentence back.
tour.size.title: Preview size
tour.size.body: Sets the size of every preview. The keys below do the same, and so does scrolling while you hold {mod}.
tour.search.title: Search
tour.search.body: Matches family names, tags, formats, foundries and your own notes. Press / from anywhere to jump here.
tour.views.title: Grid, list or cards
tour.views.body: Grid gives each family a line of text, list fits more rows with sizes and style counts, and cards show cover images and large specimens.
tour.card.title: A font family
tour.card.body: Name, format badge and number of styles. Click the style count to see every weight. Click the card to inspect it, or right-click it for collections, cover images, export and copying names or paths.
tour.inspector.title: The inspector
tour.inspector.body: Opens when you click a family: every style, variable axes you can drag, the full glyph set, license text, notes and tags. Drag its left edge to resize it.
tour.collections.title: Collections
tour.collections.body: Folders for fonts, one per project or client. Click + to make one, then right-click any font to add it. When you drop font files on the window, you can put them straight into a collection.
tour.trash.title: Trash, About and shortcuts
tour.trash.body: Fonts you remove go to the trash first, so you can restore them. About has the version and license details.
tour.settings.title: Settings
tour.settings.body: Themes, your own accent color, the font the app itself uses and a full color editor are under Appearance. Folders, language, sounds and the sidebar layout are here too.
tour.last.title: Adding fonts
tour.last.body: Drag font files, folders or zip archives anywhere onto this window to install them. That’s the whole tour.

toast.activeUntilCloseSub: It deactivates itself when you quit ZFontManager
toast.nothingToInstallSub: No font files found in the drop
toast.cantUninstallSystemSub: System fonts are protected by the OS
toast.movedToTrashSub: Restore it any time from the Trash
toast.rightClickToAdd: Right-click any font to add it
toast.coverSetSub: It shows on the font's card, in the Cards view and in the detail panel.
toast.restartAppsSub: Apps that are already open may need a restart to notice
toast.notAnExportSub: Pick a file created by Export library data
toast.collectionExportedSub_one: {count} family, each in its own folder, in {dir}
toast.collectionExportedSub_other: {count} families, each in its own folder, in {dir}

online.offBody: Turn on the online font browser in Settings to search and download free, open-licence fonts. Nothing is contacted until you do.
online.loadingBody: One request to api.fontsource.org. It is cached for seven days afterwards.
nerd.loadingBody: One request each to github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com. It is cached for seven days afterwards.
nerd.previewNote: The preview uses the original {name}. The Nerd Font adds thousands of icons on top.
nerd.variant.standardSub: Larger icons, for most terminals and editors
nerd.variant.monoSub: Icons fit one cell, for strict terminals
nerd.rfn: “{original}” is a Reserved Font Name, so Nerd Fonts publishes the patched version as “{patched}”.
online.noMatchBody: Try a shorter search or fewer filters.
online.narrowDown_one: {count} more — narrow the search to see it
online.narrowDown_other: {count} more — narrow the search to see them
bulk.create_one: Create “{tag}” and add it to {count} font
bulk.create_other: Create “{tag}” and add it to {count} fonts
bulk.empty: You haven’t made any tags yet. Type a name and press Enter. Each tag gets its own row in the sidebar.
bulk.noMatch: No tag matches. Press Enter to create it.
bulk.hint: Click a tag, or use ↑ ↓ and Enter, to add it or take it off
appearance.themesSub: Pick one dark and one light theme. System switches between them along with your desktop.
appearance.accentSub: Used for switches, selection, the size slider and focus outlines
appearance.fontSub: Any font in your library can set the app’s own text. Font previews stay as they are.
appearance.fontMore_one: {count} more match. Keep typing to narrow it down.
appearance.fontMore_other: {count} more matches. Keep typing to narrow it down.
appearance.cornersSub: How round buttons, fields, cards and panels are
appearance.importInvalid: That file isn’t a ZFontManager theme
settingsNav.tourSub: The guided walkthrough from the first launch
sidebarSettings.widthSub: Drag the sidebar’s right edge to change it. Double-click the edge to reset.
sidebarSettings.itemsSub: Drag the handles to change the order, or click the eye to hide an item. You can also drag rows in the sidebar itself and right-click them to hide them.
side.resizeHint: Drag to resize, double-click to reset
tour.browse.title: Views of your library
tour.browse.body: Every font you have, then narrower views: favorites, your last import, what is switched on, what is on only until you quit, what is switched off, and the fonts that came with the system. The numbers update as you work.
tour.sidebar.title: Shape the sidebar
tour.sidebar.body: Drag this edge to make the sidebar wider or narrower, and double-click it to reset. Drag rows in Browse to reorder them, or right-click a row to hide it. Settings, under Sidebar, brings hidden items back.
tour.filter.title: Filters
tour.filter.body: Narrow the list by classification, language support, file format, OpenType features, or a character the font must contain. The menu opens with a search field, so you can type “cyril” instead of scrolling.
tour.sort.title: Sort order
tour.sort.body: Sort by name, number of styles, file size or glyph count.
tour.toggle.title: Switch fonts on and off
tour.toggle.body: Turns the whole family on or off for every app on this computer. Fonts you switch off disappear from other apps’ font menus but stay here. A lock means the system manages that font.
tour.pick.title: Select and favorite
tour.pick.body: The box selects the family for bulk actions. Shift-click another box to select everything in between. The star adds it to Favorites.
tour.selection.title: Bulk actions
tour.selection.body: With two or more fonts selected, this bar acts on all of them at once: switch on or off, tag, add to a collection, favorite, compare or move to the trash.
tour.compare.title: Compare
tour.compare.body: Select two to four families and press Compare, or C, to set them side by side in the same text and size.
tour.tools.title: Rescan, select all, expand
tour.tools.body: Rescan reads your font folders again. The double check selects everything currently shown. The last button opens the style list of every card at once.
tour.tags.title: Tags
tour.tags.body: Tags are labels like “display” or “licensed”. Add them in the inspector, or select several fonts and use Tag in the bar at the bottom. Each tag gets a row in the sidebar.
tour.palette.title: Command palette and shortcuts
tour.palette.body: {mod} K opens a palette where you can type any action or a font’s name. Press ? to see every keyboard shortcut.
